Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing certain alcohol permit holders to obtain alcohol in nonbeverage form directly from suppliers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to medical, hospital, mechanical, manufacturing, orscientific entities or persons obtaining nonbeverage alcohol directlyfrom suppliers; and adding a new section to chapter 66.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any person engaged in medical or dental pursuits, any person incharge of an institution regularly conducted as a hospital orsanitarium for the care of persons in ill health, or a home devotedexclusively to the care of aged persons, may obtain alcohol in anonbeverage form directly from a supplier under a permit issued underRCW 66.20.010(1). (2) Any person engaged in the mechanical or manufacturing businessor in scientific pursuits requiring the use of alcohol may obtainalcohol in a nonbeverage form directly from a supplier under a permitissued under RCW 66.20.010(2).
